frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole organism. Do not substitute a skull, slab or generic dinosaur.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: MCCM-LH 6666, near-complete articulated holotype; not a specimen replica
uncertainties: Soft-tissue thickness and outline of dorsal crest are unknown; use modest narrow triangular skin-covered crest as an explicitly artistic choice, not a proven thin sail.
Integument is not known over whole body. Neutral smooth faceted surface, no asserted all-over scaly pattern, no speculative elaborate feather fan.
Colour, stance and soft-tissue volumes are artistic. Do not copy fossil death pose or a skeletal mount as a life pose.
